verdict.rationale: Typesense's docs emphasize instant search-as-you-type and typo tolerance, but nothing in the evidence pack describes a dedicated query-suggestions/autocomplete engine driven by search-traffic analytics or a suggestions index (e.g., Typesense's 'Analytics & Query Suggestions' feature is not mentioned at all). Search-as-you-type ≠ traffic-informed suggestions, so this specific capability is unevidenced.
